Asset credits

Vehicles

The nine licensed exteriors have been simplified and adapted for game paint, windows, lights and wheels. The model index includes each title, creator, source and license. Vehicle asset manifest

Statue of Liberty

The game scales, aligns and simplifies e-sfera’s model, with baked colors at harbor distance. Statue Of Liberty Low Poly · CC BY 4.0

People and places

The character meshes use MakeHuman community assets. The bank lobby includes a cropped monochrome version of Paul Sableman’s Gunther Building. The game generates interiors from business types and trade names. Character manifest · Photograph · CC BY 2.0 · OpenStreetMap contributors
